notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629316/bda2f30c42372cfcd6ed31b5cffd8644b5b547a8.png[/img]

Thank you all for playing the demo. We have done a few updates, fixed some bugs, and added some explanation for mechanics. I hope this helps the game loop become more clear and the puzzles easier to solve. There is also a control layout image and a couple of hints in the pause menu. Please enjoy the full demo. There is a treat at the end of the 2 demo levels.
